description_expanded: About Dream On "Dream On" is a private, state-of-the-art luxury beachfront vacation rental located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Florida. Dazzling emerald-green waves and white-sugar sand greet your view from every angle of this vacation rental on 30A, both inside and out. Over 2,500 square feet of beachside ambiance has been strategically constructed over the last 2 years with the primary intention to exceed a 5-star experience. Brand-new unique furnishings and décor from ceiling to floor, beachfront master suites, a private beach boardwalk, and a private pool are just a few of the amenities that await those who seek out new vacation memories to last a lifetime! Whether you consider it the backyard or the front yard, Dream On directly faces the pristine mile and half shoreline of Seacrest Beach in 30A. Its private boardwalk leads straight out to the sand with 24/7 access to the world's most beautiful beaches. The views from the furnished deck of this beachfront rental are second to none and are accessible from both the main living area as well as the master suites. At Dream On, an incredible day at the beach doesn't have to end at sunset because the private heatable pool is always ready for fun! Both the deck and the pool are positioned perfectly, so the soundtrack of the waves and cool salt breeze is always playing. The main living space is truly the heart of this luxury 30A vacation rental and makes up about half of the square footage. Wall-to-wall windows line the entire beachside of the home, promoting the natural coastal elements of a true beach vacation experience. Side-by-side kitchen and dining spaces provide the perfect layout for the entire group to enjoy time spent preparing delicious meals and casual dining together. With an expansive living and entertainment area, family movie & game nights are an absolute MUST during your stay! There are three beachfront master suites, each with private access to the outdoor deck as well as private ensuites. The uniquely furnished bunk room features 2 twin over-queen bunks with a closet storage system to rival any professional sports team locker room! ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach, Florida, is a charming coastal community nestled along the renowned Emerald Coast. Situated between the iconic beach destinations of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach offers a tranquil escape with easy access to the area's vibrant attractions and natural splendor. Beyond its breathtaking beaches, Seacrest Beach boasts a laid-back atmosphere and a sense of community that is both welcoming and inclusive. Stroll along the cobblestone streets lined with quaint cottages and lush landscaping, and you ll discover a thriving village center brimming with boutiques, cafes, and restaurants. From eclectic eateries serving up fresh seafood to charming shops offering unique souvenirs and artisanal goods, there is something to delight every palate and preference. For those seeking outdoor recreation, Seacrest Beach offers a wealth of options to explore its natural beauty. Take a leisurely bike ride along scenic trails, meander through the unique shops and boutiques, or embark on a sunset hike to catch breathtaking views of the coastline. Nearby state parks and nature preserves provide opportunities for birdwatching, wildlife spotting, and immersive encounters with the area's diverse ecosystems. In addition to its natural attractions, Seacrest Beach hosts a variety of events and activities throughout the year, from live music performances and art festivals to farmers markets and community gatherings. Whether you are a year-round resident or a visitor seeking a memorable vacation, there's always something exciting happening in Seacrest Beach. BEACH ACCESS: * Directly Behind Dream On PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Direct Access to the Beach * Pool Heat Optional- $90 per day * 4 bikes included * 8 beach towels * 6 person golf cart included * 4 beach chairs, 2 umbrellas and a beach box (daily ice, boombox and beach towels) PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2 Vehicles DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * Additional $1000.00 refundable security deposit charged at confirmation ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales , you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
